conditioning_interface.same_parent_ablation_rule: Sequence-only, trans-only, permuted-context, reverse-complement, and matched-shuffle arms must use the same parent, rows, output axes, splits, seeds, evaluator, and calibration.

context_interface.held_donor_query_rule: Project held RNA through a mapper fit without held ATAC, held outcomes, or held-donor refitting.

observed_multiome.reason: Observed-ATAC models have a separate family-native task and must not be relabeled as RNA-conditioned models.

next_action: Wait for the complementarity and component-selection gates. If they pass, instantiate this abstract interface in one new parent-bound spec; otherwise stop without building context-Borzoi.

provisional_sequence_latent_interface.boundary_buffer_rule: At least the full selected receptive field, frozen before any fit.
provisional_sequence_latent_interface.provisional_only_reason: The 524288 by 1920 by 6144 surface is shared by the current Borzoi/Scooby evidence, but no backbone has been selected and native Borzoi authority remains blocked.
provisional_sequence_latent_interface.variant_orientation_rule: REF and ALT use the same window, reverse-complement restoration, output crop, strand map, and ALT-minus-REF sign convention.

remaining_activation_gates: Pass and freeze the prespecified complementarity trigger on development evidence only.
Select the open long-range backbone and clean cell encoder from their five-seed full-specialist shortlists.
Resolve selected-component code, checkpoint, inherited and derivative-weight terms.
Pass strict restoration, native numeric parity, reference, crop, strand and reverse-complement gates for the selected sequence parent.
Freeze exact selected-parent latent attachments, LoRA module names and rank/alpha/dropout in a new parent-bound architecture spec.
Freeze the RNA-only context mapper, feature order, normalization, missing masks, donor folds, chromosome/LD blocks and receptive-field buffer.
Implement and CPU-test neutral missing-context behavior, parameter masks, strict delta loading and all same-parent ablations.
Only then run one centralized-dispatcher L40S import, forward/backward, resume, determinism and numeric-tolerance probe before any training bundle.
scope: Outcome-blind reconciliation of existing Borzoi sequence-latent, Regular Corgi FiLM, and released Scooby context-decoder infrastructure for the one conditional context-model slot. This freezes an abstract component interface only. It does not select a backbone or cell encoder, implement a composite, fit a mapper or model, open a new checkpoint, read biological outcomes, authorize GPU work, or change the conditional trigger.
